requirements.title: Automatic Replies to Social-Media Comments
requirements.definition: Automatically respond to comments received through the supported connected social-media accounts.
requirements.boundary_note: Comment replies are separate from keyword-conditioned responses and from other engagement triggers because they can be configured and tested independently; platform and account counts remain scope attributes.

requirements.title: Automatic Responses to Social-Media Likes
requirements.definition: Automatically initiate an applicable response when a supported social-media account receives a like.
requirements.boundary_note: Like-triggered behavior is independently configurable and may have different platform support from comment or direct-message replies.

requirements.title: Automatic Replies to Direct Messages
requirements.definition: Automatically respond to incoming direct messages on connected social-media platforms where the integration supports that behavior.
requirements.boundary_note: Direct-message automation is independently testable from public comment and like triggers; it is established in the project opening description but lacks a target-explicit message anchor in the supplied history.

requirements.title: Keyword-Triggered Social Responses
requirements.definition: Recognize configured social-engagement keywords and initiate the corresponding automatic response and follow-up route.
requirements.boundary_note: The listed keywords are routing-table parameters of one trigger mechanism; delivery of each associated resource remains a separate behavior because trigger recognition can succeed while content routing fails.

requirements.title: Keyword-Associated Resource Delivery
requirements.definition: Deliver the appropriate project file or PDF associated with each configured keyword as part of the automated follow-up.
requirements.boundary_note: Housing, loan restructuring, loan protection coverage, property levies, and mortgage quote are mappings within one delivery mechanism rather than separate Requirements; document rendering integrity is independently testable.

requirements.title: Complete PDF Content Display
requirements.definition: Ensure that a delivered PDF displays all of its intended words and content rather than omitting text.
requirements.boundary_note: PDF rendering completeness can fail independently after the correct resource has been selected and delivered, so it is separate from keyword routing and resource delivery.

requirements.title: Social Engagement Lead Capture
requirements.definition: Capture people produced by the configured social-media engagement automations as leads with the required contact information.
requirements.boundary_note: Lead creation is separate from subsequent workflow enrollment because a contact can be captured successfully without entering the correct workflow; this Requirement is explicit in the project opening description but has no target-explicit supplied message anchor.

requirements.title: Appropriate Lead Workflow Enrollment
requirements.definition: Enroll each captured social-media lead into the workflow appropriate to its trigger or campaign.
requirements.boundary_note: Workflow enrollment is independently verifiable from lead capture and may require different routing logic; it is established by the project opening description but lacks a target-explicit message anchor.

unresolved_candidates.description: The supplied messages specify coverage for 8 Facebook, 7 Instagram, and 5 TikTok accounts, while the project opening description specifies 2 Facebook Pages, 2 Instagram Accounts, and 1 TikTok Account. The intended account coverage should be confirmed before extracting scope-sensitive Events.
The PDF display failure is clear, but the supplied evidence does not identify which keyword-associated document was being tested.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Amara Keene,

For 8 FB, 7 IG, and 5 TK accounts, I need your help repairing and optimizing the social-media automation funnel. The goal is to have GHL operate like ManyChat.

Please handle the following scope:
* Assess the current funnel and automation configuration.
* Find and correct anything stopping the automation from working properly.
* Make replies to comments and likes automatic.
* Where applicable, configure keyword-triggered responses.
* Run an end-to-end test of the complete workflow.
* Apply any changes that are necessary.
